description: This file defines the 'Random' class within the PhpSpreadsheet Calculation namespace, implementing random number generation functions such as RAND, RANDBETWEEN, and RANDARRAY for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: A class providing random number generation functions for spreadsheet calculations including RAND, RANDBETWEEN, and RANDARRAY.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Returns a random float between 0 and 1.

methods.name: randBetween
methods.description: Returns a random integer between specified min and max values, or an array of such values.

methods.name: randArray
methods.description: Generates a 2D array of random numbers with specified dimensions and value range.
